title: shorea balanocarpoides
intro: Shorea balanocarpoides, commonly known as Belian, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae, native to Southeast Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Shorea balanocarpoides are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
